title: Vibrant Horizons
description: Vibrant Horizons was a Modpack designed for a small Private SMP. It has been Released to the public so all can enjoy :]
body:
## **🗻Vibrant Horizons:🗻**
**"Vibrant Horizons"** is a **client-side and server-side** Modpack, **developed for Fabric**, designed for a Small Private Minecraft SMP and released to the Public for all to enjoy. **As of Fabric Version 26.1.2, The Modpack has been built from the ground up** to stabilising optimisation and **adding-new/removing-old** content.**"Vibrant Horizons"** is comprised of an expansive library of quality-of-life Mods that drastically improve the Visuals and Performance of a Minecraft while staying true to the Vanilla feel. The Modpack incorporates many modern game mechanics that do a GREAT job at seamlessly immersing the player to the game, all while staying true to the Vanilla feel - Think of it as Vanilla Perfected ;]
